name: Feature Scrollspy
description: Sticky scrollspy menu beside a column of feature cards. Active menu item gets a brand dot as cards cross the viewport; cards rise in on first view; one dark quote card breaks the rhythm.
interactions: scrollspy: active card = last card whose top crossed the 40%-viewport line; menu color/weight/dot transition 250ms
menu item click smooth-scrolls its card to viewport center
cards + header reveal once at 88% viewport: opacity/translateY(40px), 1s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1)
dual drive: passive scroll listener + permanent rAF loop
below 900px: menu unsticks and wraps horizontally, cards stack
prefers-reduced-motion: reveals render in place, transitions off
